svg.title: Arda Çabuk — embedded software and machine learning
svg.desc: A ray-marched room at night, drawn in ASCII. A small pink neon on the wall reads arda çabuk and stutters now and then. Under it someone with light-brown hair, a rust hoodie and headphones sits at a desk with their back to you, nodding to the music and typing; the monitor reads arda@jetson and shows a scrolling vibration trace marked nominal, a development board blinks beside the keyboard, steam rises from a mug under a desk lamp. Through a tall arched window a cat sits on the sill against a crescent moon, stars twinkle, shooting stars cross, cars pass on the hill road and wind turbines turn on the ridge with red lights blinking. Fairy lights twinkle under the ceiling and dust drifts in the moonlight falling through the window.
